summary_en: SAN-AI OBBLI increased its share buyback authorization by 50% to 1.5 million shares (2.45% of outstanding shares) and raised the budget ceiling to ¥3.55 billion from ¥2.3 billion, extending the acquisition period through March 31, 2027. The expansion follows upward revision of fiscal 2027 earnings guidance, targeting total shareholder return payout of 100%.
title_en: Notice Regarding Partial Amendment to Matters Relating to Acquisition of Treasury Stock (Increase in Number of Shares and Total Amount, and Extension of Period)
translation_en_brief:
On November 10, 2026, SAN-AI OBBLI's board of directors resolved to amend the treasury stock acquisition program originally authorized on August 6, 2026. The company increased the maximum number of shares to be acquired from 1.0 million to 1.5 million shares, representing 2.45% of outstanding shares (excluding treasury stock). The total acquisition budget was raised from ¥2.3 billion to ¥3.55 billion, and the acquisition period was extended from December 31, 2026 to March 31, 2027.

As of November 9, 2026, the company had already acquired 808,300 shares for a total of ¥1,937,525,600 under the original authorization. The acquisition method remains open market purchase on the Tokyo Stock Exchange.

The expansion was driven by an upward revision to the company's earnings guidance for the fiscal year ending March 2027, announced on the same date. Management indicated that the increased buyback authorization supports the execution of flexible capital policies. With this expansion, the company expects to achieve its mid-term management plan target of 100% total shareholder return payout ratio for the current fiscal year.
